projects.name: FiberLens
projects.tagline: Your DWG is the map — smart CAD for fibre-network field engineers.
points: Opens and edits DWG/DXF on Android, iOS and the web, fully offline, with the engineer’s live GPS position drawn inside the drawing.
WebGL2 renderer: 85k entities (~550k segments) in under 1 ms of GPU time. Fibre trace to the OLT, splitters, a 9-step georeferencing wizard, BOQ and 10 reports.

projects.name: AI Live Translator
projects.tagline: You speak Arabic, they hear German — live, in any meeting app, 100% on your PC.
points: Two-way pipeline running in parallel for both sides: Silero VAD → faster-whisper → NLLB-200 → Piper voices, across 103 languages.
A C# helper on the Windows process-loopback API captures only the meeting’s audio, so there’s no echo loop. CUDA with CPU fallback, one-click installer.

projects.name: FixTrack
projects.tagline: Replaces the cashier software phone-repair shops in Egypt run today.
points: Repair workflow (intake → diagnosis → customer approval → warranty delivery) plus a barcode POS, IMEI tracking, used-phone purchases and mobile wallets.
The shop PC is the server: an embedded HTTP server and SQLite that the shop’s phones join over Wi-Fi, offline. Firebase for QR tracking and branches; Ed25519-signed licences.

projects.name: Order Ly
projects.tagline: Cafe customers scan the table QR, order and pay from their own phone.
points: QR web menu in Arabic and English with sizes, extras and upsell; pay by cash, card, Vodafone Cash or InstaPay with a transfer screenshot the cashier confirms; live order status, call the waiter, ask for the bill.

The cashier PC runs a self-restarting local server with SQLite, and orders reach it through Firebase Realtime Database in about a second. Bar and kitchen display, per-station ticket printing, recipe-based stock, menu-engineering reports.

projects.name: NightGold V3
projects.tagline: Password manager and file locker for Windows — no master password to forget.
points: Unlocks with a 6-digit TOTP code; every secret AES-256 encrypted in a local vault; generator with Arabic letters; weak and reused password audit.
Quick Lock turns any file or folder into an encrypted .ngLock in place and re-locks it on Windows lock, sleep or shutdown.

projects.name: Password Generator V2
projects.tagline: NightGold V2 — where the generator grew into a password manager.
points: Password generator with a live strength meter, plus a saved-credentials vault with search, favourites and categories.
Vault unlocked by a TOTP code paired through a QR code; Arabic / English interface with i18next; packaged as a Windows installer.

projects.name: Password Generator V1
projects.tagline: Where NightGold started: a customizable password generator with a local vault.
points: Generates 8–64 character passwords with upper case, numbers, symbols and optional Arabic letters; one-click copy.
Saves site, username and password in an AES-256-CBC encrypted SQLite vault unlocked by an authenticator code; Arabic RTL and English.

projects.name: GeoSnap Pro
projects.tagline: A GPS camera built for site inspections.
points: Live watermark in four stamp templates, real EXIF GPS on every photo, and drag-the-pin correction for GPS drift.
In-app gallery, PDF inspection reports, a native Java bridge, obfuscated and signed release builds.

projects.name: Wedding Decor Bot
projects.tagline: A Messenger and WhatsApp sales assistant that speaks Egyptian Arabic.
points: Express webhook connecting Messenger and the WhatsApp Cloud API to Google Gemini.
Qualifies leads by asking for event type, venue and date; deployed on Render.

projects.name: Opti Nav
projects.tagline: The desktop CAD viewer that became FiberLens.
points: Multi-document tabs, model and paper-space layouts, markup tools.
A parser registry that retries across engines to open DWG, DXF, STEP, IGES and STL.

projects.name: Basket
projects.tagline: Supermarket & grocery POS for Windows + Android: scale barcodes, expiry dates (FEFO), multiple cashiers, delivery orders (Flutter, offline-first, LAN server)
